title: DeHub Token and Exchange Listings Update
html:
DeHub is preparing exchange listings for the new token and the app economy it supports. We currently estimate that listing proceedings will begin within 30–45 days of this September 18 update, with official listings targeted for late October or early November. These are estimates; we will announce confirmed listings when they are ready.

Tokens in the app

DeHub tokens can now be used as AI credits to generate content and prompts in the app. Tokens that users buy and spend on these features return to the pool, while tokens that buyers hold reduce the amount available in that pool.

AI generation also has a compute cost. After those costs and other overheads, we plan to use remaining profit to buy tokens back from the same pool and share them with stakers. Once that pool is empty, buybacks would instead be routed through DEX listings.

For an illustration, if a user buys $100 of tokens and spends all of them on content generation, margins on features such as image or video generation currently range from 10% to 50%. Depending on the feature and its costs, up to $50 of that $100 could therefore be available for buybacks. This is an example, not a fixed return or guaranteed buyback amount.

Trading and listing plans

The token contract has been live for nearly a month. Anyone has been able to list and sell their tokens on a DEX since it went live, and we provided OTC options to people who could not wait for exchange listings. We know changes to trading access matter to the community and will keep sharing updates as plans firm up.

We expect to announce official exchange listings soon. Our current target is the end of October or early November 2026. We have also been in contact with CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko about continuing price tracking after those dates.

Explore token purchase options · Read the original announcement on X
